purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel geometry for Songkhla, Thailand; access failures and general national-service evidence are not treated as evidence that no cadastre exists.
name: Songkhla

officialSources.observation: Thai Department of Lands official land-parcel map information center. The current page lists LandsState, LANDSPUBLIC, CondoMaps, and iPortal services; it is national service evidence, not a verified Songkhla parcel response.

Official Songkhla Provincial Land Office page identifies the provincial land office in Bo Yang, Mueang Songkhla, with surveying and registration contacts. This is a local custodian contact page, but it exposes no public parcel geometry endpoint.

Official Department of Lands user manual indexed for Land Map Service (LMS), showing parcel-map viewer concepts and WGS84 geographic display; it does not provide a current Songkhla response or stable native parcel identity.

requests.outcome: Official page returned HTML. Current page content identified LandsState, LANDSPUBLIC, CondoMaps, and iPortal, but no parcel layer schema, CRS, native ID, or geometry was returned by the page request.

Bounded anonymous curl request timed out after 20 seconds before headers/body were returned. No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup, or TLS-verification disablement was used.
Bounded anonymous HTTPS request failed to connect within the request timeout; no JavaScript/configuration, API route, schema, CRS, ID, or geometry was obtained.
Bounded anonymous HTTP request failed to connect; no redirect or parcel response was obtained.
Official local custodian contact page inspected. It established Songkhla Provincial Land Office responsibility/contact information, but no public map/API route or parcel geometry.

registryBasis: A first-party Songkhla Provincial Land Office custodian is evidenced, and the Department of Lands documents national parcel-map services. No anonymous city-specific cadastral response or geometry was verified, so registryFound remains null under the queue rule.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Thai Department of Lands public parcel-map discovery and Songkhla Provincial Land Office custodian review.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official national/local service pages only; no bounded Songkhla parcel response, safe native ID, schema, CRS, or full polygon geometry was verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
remainingUncertainty: The official LandsMaps/LMS service may expose Songkhla parcel geometry interactively, but its current public JavaScript/configuration and anonymous API response could not be established in this attempt. The exact WUP point was preserved without shifting it; no timeout or point miss is treated as citywide absence.
